trap.label: for / since
trap.why: Em português 'leciono aqui desde 2019' usa o presente; em inglês duração até agora pede Present Perfect.

opts: They have been married for a year.
They are married since a year.
They were married since a year.

fix.wrong: He has a car since March.
fix.right: He has had a car since March.

fix.wrong: We know each other since years.
fix.right: We have known each other for years.

rewrite.prompt: Present perfect: “I live in Lima. (for six months)”
rewrite.answer: I have lived in Lima for six months.
How long have you studied Spanish?

rewrite.prompt: Present perfect: “She has a cold. (since Monday)”
rewrite.answer: She has had a cold since Monday.
